newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 1998 GDP growth seen at around 6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 1998 GDP growth seen at around 6.0 pct.

text.p: South Korea's gross domestic product (GDP) is forecast to grow around 6.0 percent in real terms next year, a finance minister said on Monday.
GDP growth in 1997 was seen at 6.0 percent, against 7.1 percent in 1996, Kang Kyong-shik told a parliamentary committee.
"Our economy is expected to recover somewhat next year, but not by much," Kang said.
Kang did not give further details.

The central Bank of Korea said on Monday the economy would grow 6.0 percent this year against a 7.1 percent rise a year earlier. The central bank said improving exports and construction investment would contribute to the GDP rise later this year.
